module: Generic display of a sorted list of sites elements (locations, zones, parking spots), used as a tab by the sites editor. The module returns a class constructor C that receives an 'elementEditor' (locations, zones or parkingSpots) to which it delegates click test, creation, deletion, gizmo and element drawing. It handles search by name, multiple selection, renaming, color, custom fields (copy/paste) and undoable changes.
notes: In drawList, Ctrl or Shift gives the 'toggle' mode; the following branch (Shift alone would give 'add') is unreachable.

createByShift (default true): Shift+click creates an element; otherwise a 'Create...' button is displayed. selectByClick (default true): the click selects via elementEditor:hitTest; otherwise the click is delegated to elementEditor:input.
If several elements are selected, the name and color fields are disabled.

C.desc: Object returned by the constructor. Fields: key, index (last selected id), selections (list of ids), objects, sorted, elementEditor, activeTags, createByShift, selectByClick, windowDescription.

init.desc: Constructor: prepares the selection (editor.selection[key]), the custom fields and the search box.

setSites.desc: Sets the edited sites, keeps objects and sorted, passes them to the element editor and recomputes the active tags.

updateActiveTags.desc: Recounts the tags used by the elements (table tag to count).

selected.desc: Called when the tab becomes active: clears the selection and sets the objects to 'normal' drawing.

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left: clears the selection and sets the objects to 'faded' drawing.

selectElement.desc: Selects the element with the given id (nil to deselect), updates highlight, element editor, tags and edit fields.

mode.desc: nil replaces the selection; 'toggle' or 'add' extends it (toggle removes an already selected id).

adoptElement.desc: Changes the list selection without calling elementEditor:select, to keep a gizmo drag in progress (used after the Shift duplication).

draw.desc: Draws the tab; handles mouse input if the gizmo is allowed.

input.desc: Handles clicks in the world: creation by Shift+click, selection by hitTest or delegation to elementEditor:input.

setField.desc: Changes a field (name, color...) of all the selected elements via an undoable action.

drawList.desc: Draws the filterable list on the left and the element edit panel on the right.

drawCustomFields.desc: Draws the custom fields widget and the Copy Fields / Paste Fields buttons.
